title: Women's Financial Rights & Divyangjan Schemes 🌸
description: Women's legal inheritance rights, Mahila Samman Savings Certificate, Divyangjan subsidies, and financial autonomy.

cards.title: Hindu Succession Act & Equal Ancestral Rights ⚖️
cards.content:
2005 Amendment to Hindu Succession Act: **Daughters have 100% EQUAL legal right in ancestral property** as sons — whether married or unmarried!

Stridhan (wedding gifts/jewellery given to woman) is **exclusively her absolute property**. Neither husband nor in-laws have legal right over Stridhan.

options: Haan, shaadi ke baad beti parivar ka hissa nahi rehti
Nahi, 2005 Amendment ke baad beti ko equal coparcenary right milta hai
quizData.explanation: 2005 Hindu Succession Act amendment guarantees equal coparcenary rights to daughters regardless of marital status.

cards.title: Mahila Samman Savings & Divyangjan Grants 💳
cards.content:
**Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)**: Fixed 7.5% per annum interest, 2-year tenure for women/girls with partial withdrawal facility.

**Divyangjan Financial Support**: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) offers concessional loans (4%-8% interest) for skill & higher education.
